checks.name: no initdb or database files before Vault unlock
first boot unlocks from Vault and starts PostgreSQL
LUKS2 header has one keyslot and no TPM or enrollment tokens
database reads work and raw storage contains no plaintext canary
application restart reuses the already unlocked database
concurrent container cannot take ownership of the same storage
clean restart preserves the encrypted database and Vault key
missing Vault key leaves existing ciphertext untouched and PostgreSQL locked
restoring Vault recovers the original encrypted database
container crash recovers the encrypted mapping and PostgreSQL WAL
corrupt Vault fails closed without replacing credentials or formatting storage
